# Home Page and Site Navigation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the Stats Engine front page with a paper-first home page about Alfredo Effendy for job market committees, move Stats Engine to `stats-engine/`, and give every page a top bar with visible Research · Teaching · C.V. · Tools links.

**Architecture:** The site is generated by `tools/gen-pages.mjs` from page modules in `tools/pages/*.mjs` and shared chrome in `tools/shell.mjs`, then bundled by Vite (`base: './'`, all links relative) and deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/pages.yml`. The home page is a new page module written to `index.html`; the lab workspace is written to `stats-engine/index.html` instead. A new link checker runs after every build so the move cannot ship a broken link.

**Tech Stack:** Node 24, Vite 8, TypeScript 7 (type-check only), Vitest 5, plain ES modules for the generators, Pillow (Python) for the headshot.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-01-home-page-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Every internal link is relative and never starts with `/` (the site is served from `/website/`). Route constants live in `ROUTES` in `tools/shell.mjs`.
- Facts about the author come only from `notes/source/cv.md` and the job market paper. Never publish the phone number or referees' emails.
- Colours only through design tokens (`var(--accent)`, `var(--gold)`, `var(--muted)`, …); both themes must work. Spacing tokens that exist: `--s-1 --s-2 --s-3 --s-4 --s-6 --s-8 --s-12` (there is no `--s-10`).
- `base.css` has `[hidden] { display: none !important; }`: any element that must show while `hidden` needs `display: … !important` with a more specific selector.
- Size budgets (gzip, `tools/report-size.mjs`): workspace HTML+CSS ≤ 24 000 B; every other page ≤ 30 000 B; up-front JS per page ≤ 20 000 B; each image ≤ 160 000 B.
- Preserve each file's line endings. CRLF files touched here: `tools/pages/research.mjs`, `src/styles/cv.css`. After editing, `git diff --stat` must show only the intended lines (a whole-file diff means the endings changed).
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (base.css already disables CSS animation under it).
- Voice: few words, plain, no marketing tone. Research fields are exactly: International Finance · Asset Pricing · Macro-Finance.
- Run all `npm`/`node` commands from `/Users/aeffendy/Website/stats-engine` with Node on the PATH: `export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"` (Task 0).

## Review Focus

1. **Old shared lab links** (`/website/?lab=regression&seed=7`, also with `theme=` or a `#hash`) must land on the same run under `stats-engine/`; `?theme=dark` alone or `?labx=1` must not redirect. Pinned by tests in Task 2.
2. **Workspace assets after the move** (font preload, CSS `__ROOT__` URLs, module script, lazy chunks, CSV worker) must resolve from `stats-engine/`. Pinned by the link checker (Task 1) plus the `dist/stats-engine/index.html` check and browser check in Task 2.
3. **No JavaScript:** on wide screens Research, Teaching and C.V. show in the bar; Stats Engine stays reachable from the footer. Pinned by the "no `hidden` on the site menu" and footer tests in Task 3.
4. **Phone widths:** the menu button opens one sheet with every link; Escape closes it and returns focus; rotating to a wide screen leaves the links in the bar. Pinned by the browser checks in Task 3.
5. **Keyboard:** Tools opens with Enter/Space, Tab past its last item closes it, Escape returns focus to the button. Pinned by the browser checks in Task 3 (behaviour comes from the existing `disclosure()`).

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement** — `tools/check-links.mjs`

```js
// Fails the build when a page links to a file that is not in dist/: every relative href, src and
// srcset URL in dist/**/*.html must resolve to a file. Links that leave the site (http:, mailto:,
// data:, //host) and in-page anchors are skipped. A root-absolute link ("/x") is always reported,
// because the site is served from a sub-folder. 404.html is skipped (its script fixes its own link).
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const walk = (dir) =>
  readdirSync(dir).flatMap((name) => {
    const full = join(dir, name);
    return statSync(full).isDirectory() ? walk(full) : [full];
  });

/** Every link target in a page's markup: href and src values first, then each URL in a srcset. */
export function refsIn(html) {
  const refs = [...html.matchAll(/\s(?:href|src)="([^"]*)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/\ssrcset="([^"]*)"/g)) for (const part of m[1].split(',')) refs.push(part.trim().split(/\s+/)[0]);
  return refs;
}

/** "page: link" for every link in the site at `dir` that does not resolve to a file there. */
export function brokenLinks(dir) {
  const problems = [];
  for (const page of walk(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.html') && !f.endsWith('404.html'))) {
    const name = relative(dir, page).replaceAll('\\', '/');
    for (const ref of refsIn(readFileSync(page, 'utf8'))) {
      if (!ref || ref.startsWith('#') || ref.startsWith('//') || /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(ref)) continue;
      if (ref.startsWith('/')) {
        problems.push(`${name}: ${ref} (root-absolute)`);
        continue;
      }
      const path = decodeURIComponent(ref.replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/[?#].*$/, ''));
      if (!path) continue; // "?lab=data" or "#x": the page itself
      let target = resolve(dirname(page), path);
      if (path.endsWith('/') || path.endsWith('..') || (existsSync(target) && statSync(target).isDirectory())) target = join(target, 'index.html');
      if (!existsSync(target)) problems.push(`${name}: ${ref}`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const problems = brokenLinks(join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'dist'));
  if (problems.length) {
    console.error(`Broken links:\n  ${problems.join('\n  ')}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('links: all resolve');
}
```

```js
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { LAB_REDIRECT, pages } from '../tools/pages/home.mjs';

const home = async () => (await pages())[0];

/** Runs the head script against a fake location; returns the URLs it navigated to. */
function redirect(search, hash = '') {
  const calls = [];
  new Function('location', LAB_REDIRECT)({ search, hash, replace: (u) => calls.push(u) });
  return calls;
}

describe('old shared lab links', () => {
  it('forward to the same run under stats-engine/', () => {
    expect(redirect('?lab=regression&seed=7', '#x')).toEqual(['stats-engine/?lab=regression&seed=7#x']);
    expect(redirect('?theme=dark&lab=data')).toEqual(['stats-engine/?theme=dark&lab=data']);
  });
  it('leave every other address alone', () => {
    expect(redirect('')).toEqual([]);
    expect(redirect('?theme=dark')).toEqual([]);
    expect(redirect('?labx=1')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('home page', () => {
  it('is the site root, runs the redirect in <head>, and has no About Me', async () => {
    const p = await home();
    expect(p.path).toBe('index.html');
    expect(p.current).toBe('home');
    expect(p.extraHead).toContain(LAB_REDIRECT);

  it('leads with the author, the fields and the job market', async () => {

    expect(html).toContain('<li>International Finance</li><li>Asset Pricing</li><li>Macro-Finance</li>');

    expect(html).toContain('href="https://econ.washington.edu/people/alfredo-effendy"');

});
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `tools/pages/home.mjs` (hero only; Task 4 adds the rest)**

```js
// Home (index.html): the author first, for job market committees: name, role, fields and how to get
// the C.V. and the paper. Facts only from notes/source/cv.md and the job market paper.
import { AUTHOR, EMAIL, FIELDS, PROFILE, ROUTES } from '../shell.mjs';

const CV_PDF = 'files/alfredo-effendy-cv.pdf';
const JMP_PDF = 'files/when-yield-curves-invert-together.pdf';
const NEW_TAB = '<span class="sr"> (opens in a new tab)</span>';

/** Old shared lab runs (/?lab=…) move to Stats Engine; runs in <head> before first paint. */
export const LAB_REDIRECT = `if(/(?:^\\?|&)lab=/.test(location.search))location.replace(${JSON.stringify(ROUTES.labs)}+location.search+location.hash)`;

const hero = (root) => `<header class="h-hero">
<div class="h-wrap h-hero-in">
<div class="h-id">
<h1>${AUTHOR}</h1>
<p class="h-role">Ph.D. candidate in Economics, University of Washington<span class="h-exp"> · expected 2027</span></p>
<ul class="h-fields" aria-label="Fields">${FIELDS.map((f) => `<li>${f}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
<p class="h-market">On the 2026–2027 academic job market</p>
<p class="h-actions">
<a class="btn primary" href="${root}${CV_PDF}" download="Alfredo-Effendy-CV.pdf" type="application/pdf">Download C.V.</a>
<a class="btn" href="${root}${JMP_PDF}" type="application/pdf">Job market paper (PDF)</a>
<a class="btn" href="mailto:${EMAIL}">${EMAIL}</a>
<a class="btn arrow" href="${PROFILE}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">UW Economics profile${NEW_TAB}</a>
</p>
</div>
</div>
</header>`;

export const pages = async () => [
  {
    path: 'index.html',
    title: `${AUTHOR} · Economics, University of Washington`,
    description: `${AUTHOR}, Ph.D. candidate in Economics at the University of Washington (expected 2027), working on ${FIELDS.join(', ').toLowerCase()}: job market paper, teaching, C.V. and tools.`,
    current: 'home',
    css: ['home'],
    extraHead: `<script>${LAB_REDIRECT}</script>\n`,
    body: (root) => `<main id="main" class="home">
${hero(root)}
</main>`,
  },
];
```

```js
/** Top-bar section links, in order: [current key, route, label]. */
const NAV = [
  ['research', ROUTES.research, 'Research'],
  ['teaching', ROUTES.teaching, 'Teaching'],
  ['cv', ROUTES.cv, 'C.V.'],
];
/** The Tools menu: [current key, route, name, one line]. */
export const TOOLS = [['labs', ROUTES.labs, 'Stats Engine', 'Statistics simulations for teaching']];
export const MENU_ICON = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg>`;

/**
 * The top bar on every page: [Σ] Alfredo Effendy · tagline · Research Teaching C.V. Tools ▾ · theme.
 * `current` ('home' | 'research' | 'teaching' | 'cv' | 'labs') sets aria-current. On the workspace
 * (`lab: true`) the Σ button controls the tab rail and the tagline, "Stats Engine", is the page's <h1>.
 * Phones fold the links into one sheet behind the menu button (src/ui/chrome.ts).
 */
export function topbar({ root = './', current = 'home', lab = false, tagline } = {}) {
  const here = (key) => (current === key ? ' aria-current="page"' : '');
  const line = tagline ?? (lab ? `${MARK}Stats Engine` : { research: 'Research', teaching: 'Teaching', cv: 'C.V.' }[current] ?? '');
  const tag = lab ? 'h1' : 'p';
  const sigma = lab
    ? `<button class="icon-btn nav-toggle" id="nav" type="button" aria-label="Labs" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tabs">${SIGMA}</button>\n`
    : '';
  const tools = TOOLS.map(([key, route, name, note]) => `<li><a href="${root}${route}"${here(key)}><b>${name}</b><small>${note}</small></a></li>`).join('');
  return `<header class="topbar">
${sigma}<a class="brand" href="${root}${ROUTES.home}"${here('home')}>${AUTHOR}</a>
${line ? `<${tag} class="tagline">${line}</${tag}>` : ''}
<nav class="site-nav" aria-label="Main">
<button class="icon-btn menu-btn" id="menuBtn" type="button" aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="siteMenu">${MENU_ICON}</button>
<div class="site-menu" id="siteMenu">
<ul class="nav-links">${NAV.map(([key, route, label]) => `<li><a href="${root}${route}"${here(key)}>${label}</a></li>`).join('')}</ul>
<div class="tools-menu">
<button class="nav-btn" id="toolsBtn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="toolsList"${TOOLS.some(([key]) => key === current) ? ' data-current' : ''}>Tools</button>
<ul class="bar-menu tools-list" id="toolsList" hidden>${tools}</ul>
</div>
</div>
</nav>
<button class="icon-btn theme-btn" id="theme" type="button" aria-label="Dark theme" aria-pressed="false">${THEME_ICONS}</button>
</header>`;
}
```

```ts
// Wide screens keep Research, Teaching, C.V. and Tools in the bar (CSS shows the menu even while it is

}
```

```python
"""Crop the author's headshot (notes/source/headshot.jpg) square and write the home page's two sizes.

Run from the project root: /opt/anaconda3/bin/python tools/make-headshot.py   (needs Pillow with WebP)
Replace notes/source/headshot.jpg with a larger original and rerun to sharpen the result.
"""
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "notes" / "source" / "headshot.jpg"
OUT = ROOT / "static" / "img"

img = Image.open(SRC).convert("RGB")
w, h = img.size
side = min(w, h)
left = (w - side) // 2
square = img.crop((left, 0, left + side, side))  # keep the top of the frame: the face is in the upper half
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for px in (200, 400):
    out = OUT / f"alfredo-effendy-{px}.webp"
    square.resize((min(px, side),) * 2, Image.LANCZOS).save(out, "WEBP", quality=82, method=6)
    print(f"wrote {out.relative_to(ROOT)} ({out.stat().st_size} bytes)")
```

```js
<p class="h-sum">${SUMMARY}</p>
<dl class="h-facts">${KEY_FACTS.map(([v, k]) => `<div><dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd></div>`).join('')}</dl>
<p class="h-paper-actions"><a class="btn primary" href="${summary}">Read the summary</a><a class="btn" href="${root}${PDF}" type="application/pdf">PDF</a></p>
</div>
</article>`,
  );
}

const progress = (root) =>
  section(
    'work-in-progress',
    'Work in progress',
    `<ul class="h-wip">${IN_PROGRESS.map(([title]) => `<li>${title}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
<p class="h-more"><a class="h-go" href="${root}${ROUTES.research}">Research</a></p>`,
  );

const teaching = (root, courses) =>
  section(
    'teaching',
    'Teaching',
    `<p class="h-lead">Instructor of record for ${count(courses.length)} University of Washington courses.</p>
<ul class="h-courses">
${courses
  .map((c) => {
    const syllabus = syllabusLinks(c.slug, root);
    return `<li><a class="h-course" href="${root}${ROUTES.teaching}${c.slug}/"><b>${c.code}</b> <span>${c.title}</span></a><span class="h-when">${c.when}</span>${
      syllabus ? `<span class="h-syl">Syllabus: ${syllabus}</span>` : ''
    }</li>`;
  })
  .join('\n')}
</ul>
<p class="h-more"><a class="h-go" href="${root}${ROUTES.teaching}">All teaching</a></p>`,
  );

const tools = (root) =>
  section(
    'tools',
    'Tools',
    `<ul class="h-tools">
<li class="h-tool"><a href="${labHref(root)}">${MARK}<b>Stats Engine</b><span>Six statistics simulations for teaching, from distributions to regression, plus your own data.</span></a></li>
</ul>`,
  );
```

```css
/* Photo beside the text on wide screens, above it on phones. */
.h-photo { width: 11rem; height: 11rem; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--tint); }
@media (min-width: 40.01rem) {
  .h-hero-in { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--s-8); }
}

.h-body { display: grid; gap: var(--s-12); padding-block: var(--s-8) var(--s-12); }
.h-sec { display: grid; gap: var(--s-4); }
.h-h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-3); font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.h-h2::before { content: ""; width: 1.5rem; height: 1px; background: var(--accent); }

/* Job market paper: text and the key numbers, with Figure 1 beside it on wide screens. */
.h-paper { display: grid; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.h-thumb { display: block; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.h-thumb img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.h-paper-body { display: grid; gap: var(--s-3); padding: var(--s-6); }
.h-paper h3 { font: 600 clamp(1.375rem, 1.1rem + 1vw, 1.75rem)/1.2 var(--font-display); text-wrap: balance; }
.h-paper h3 a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.h-sum { max-width: 62ch; line-height: 1.6; text-wrap: pretty; }
.h-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(9rem, 1fr)); gap: var(--s-2); }
.h-facts div { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 2px; padding: var(--s-1) var(--s-3); border-left: 2px solid var(--gold); }
.h-facts dd { font: 600 1.25rem/1.2 var(--font-display); color: var(--accent); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.h-facts dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted); }
.h-paper-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--s-2); }
@media (min-width: 56rem) {
  .h-paper { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .h-thumb { order: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
}

.h-wip { display: grid; gap: var(--s-2); }
.h-wip li { padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4); background: var(--surface); border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 600 1.0625rem/1.35 var(--font-display); }

.h-lead { color: var(--muted); }
.h-courses { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.h-courses li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px var(--s-4); padding-block: var(--s-3); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.h-course b { margin-right: var(--s-2); font: 600 1.0625rem/1.3 var(--font-display); color: var(--accent); }
.h-course span { font-weight: 600; }
.h-course:hover span { color: var(--accent); }
.h-when { font: 600 0.8125rem/1.6 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--gold-ink); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.h-syl { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted); }
.h-syl a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 35%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.h-syl a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.h-more { font-size: 0.875rem; }
.h-go { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--s-2); font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); }
.h-go::after { content: "\2192"; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.h-go:hover::after { transform: translateX(3px); }

.h-tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 20rem), 1fr)); gap: var(--s-3); }
.h-tool a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px var(--s-3); align-items: center; padding: var(--s-4); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.h-tool a:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.h-tool .bmark { grid-row: span 2; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; color: var(--accent); overflow: visible; }
.h-tool b { font: 600 1.125rem/1.2 var(--font-display); color: var(--accent); }
.h-tool span { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted); }

@media (max-width: 40rem) {
  .h-photo { width: 8rem; height: 8rem; }
  .h-when { grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: left; }
}
```
